titleEn: SenseHub Lifetime: Every animal, every stage, every minute
titleZh: SenseHub Lifetime：覆盖每头牛、每个阶段、每一分钟
summaryZh: MSD Animal Health推出全球唯一覆盖奶牛全生命周期的监测系统SenseHub Lifetime，从新生犊牛到泌乳牛全程追踪活动、采食和反刍数据，提前预警疾病和发情异常。系统新增热应激报告、群体管理和定制报告功能，并计划于2027年推出青年牛管理和季节性运营模块，帮助牧场提升繁殖效率、降低发病率、优化淘汰决策。
featuredReason: 该报道详细介绍了全球首个覆盖奶牛全生命周期的智能监测系统，展示了传感器和数据分析如何从犊牛期到泌乳期全程赋能牧场管理，对智慧畜牧从业者了解前沿产品功能和行业趋势具有重要参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Sponsored SenseHub Lifetime: Every animal, every stage, every minute ![Image 1: Agriland Team By Agriland Team November 9, 2026 6:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthoragriland-team) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newssensehub-lifetime-every-animal-every-stage-every-minute) Sponsored by !Image 3 MSD Animal Health has launched SenseHub Lifetime, the world’s only system that monitors dairy animals at every stage of life. It covers newborn calves, replacement heifers, and the cow’s entire lactation. SenseHub Lifetime tracks each calf’s activity, feeding and rumination from the day she is born. It picks up the small changes in behaviour that can signal scour or pneumonia, so you can step in before clinical signs appear. Research shows that a single case of pneumonia in the first 60 days can delay a calf reaching her first lactation by up to 15 days. SenseHub Lifetime becomes your first line of defence in protecting her future performance. Turning potential into performance Across the industry, nearly one in five heifers never reach their first calving because of disease, poor growth or missed heats. Every missed heat delays breeding and pushes back her entry into the milking herd. ![Image 4](https:images.agriland.iegaOK5dKjWwo7Ks9-O9Z887yZu7p-D1oiqxTZdMs9jcrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202611msd-calf.jpg) SenseHub Lifetime tracks heifers' development and progress towards target breeding weights. It also picks up subclinical health issues and heats you might miss, giving every heifer the best chance to become a productive cow. Through transition and into lactation The transition period is one of the most critical stages of a cow's life, with up to 80% of herd health problems occurring during this time. SenseHub monitors rumination around the clock and picks up early signs of nutritional or health problems, often before symptoms are visible. This gives you time to take action, protect your herd's fertility and set cows up for a strong start to lactation. ![Image 5](https:images.agriland.iehVHfyeQ7J5D3Xo284paBEoEb8bWArGlKe1jXK6IlFH0rs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202611msd-collar.jpg) Once she is milking, real-time heat detection catches heats, silent heats and flags non-cycling cows. This helps improve conception rates and tighten the calving interval. SenseHub also tracks rumination, milk yield and milk quality. This shows how the herd responds to diet changes such as buffer feeding and flags a rising somatic cell count before performance suffers. Practical new features available in SenseHub Lifetime Lifetime also includes these practical new features to support day-to-day management on farm: Heat stress reporting: Hot weather can affect cow rumination, milk yields, and conception rates. SenseHub Lifetime alerts farmers when heat stress levels begin to rise, helping them take action before herd performance is affected. Group management: You can now track trends at group level and spot inconsistencies between batches or feeding groups. You also get immediate feedback on diet changes, such as how quickly rumination responds when buffer feeding is introduced during a grass deficit. Bespoke custom reports: Every farm is different, so SenseHub lets you build reports to suit your own system. For example, you can quickly generate a list of the cows best suited to sexed semen or flag underperforming cows that are struggling with rumination. Additional new features coming in early 2027 Youngstock Plus: A new SenseHub Youngstock feature will help farmers monitor a calf as she matures into a heifer, evaluate rearing performance, and detect the onset of puberty, allowing farmers to select the top-performing animals for their future herd. Seasonal operations module: This new feature will bring calving, breeding, and milk performance figures together in one dashboard. This will allow farmers to view the entire season at a glance, check progress against key performance indicators (KPIs), and compare performance with previous years. This makes it easier to identify under-performing animals at key times of the year, for example during the pre-calving, post-calving, breeding, and drying-off periods. ![Image 6: Breeding dashboard in the Seasonal Operations Module within SenseHub](https:images.agriland.ieCj78vPdlDGJ-wFSyDZBooQ-xLcisFojdgUMHNzv0rs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads20261126-11-breeding-dashboard-screenshot.png) Breeding dashboard in the Seasonal Operations Module within SenseHub Decisions backed by a lifetime of data At the end of lactation, her full performance history is at your fingertips. This takes the guesswork out of choosing a drying-off protocol, selecting cows suitable for selective dry cow therapy and making evidence-based culling decisions. SenseHub Dairy is the world’s leading connected ecosystem that gives you a clear, practical picture of every animal in your herd. It saves time and puts the information you need to manage it in the palm of your hand. translationZh:
MSD Animal Health推出了SenseHub Lifetime，这是全球唯一一个在奶牛生命各个阶段进行监测的系统。它覆盖新生犊牛、后备母牛以及奶牛整个泌乳期。

SenseHub Lifetime从犊牛出生当天起追踪其活动、采食和反刍情况。它能捕捉到可能预示腹泻或肺炎的细微行为变化，让你在临床症状出现之前就介入。研究表明，在出生后60天内发生一次肺炎，可使犊牛达到首次泌乳的时间推迟多达15天。SenseHub Lifetime成为保护其未来生产性能的第一道防线。

**将潜力转化为生产力**

在整个行业中，近五分之一的母牛因疾病、生长不良或漏检发情而从未达到首次产犊。每一次漏检发情都会延迟配种，推迟其进入挤奶牛群的时间。

SenseHub Lifetime追踪后备母牛的发育情况和向目标配种体重的进展。它还能发现亚临床健康问题和你可能遗漏的发情，让每头后备母牛都有最佳机会成为高产奶牛。

**度过过渡期并进入泌乳期**

过渡期是奶牛一生中最关键的阶段之一，高达80%的牛群健康问题发生在此期间。SenseHub全天候监测反刍情况，在症状可见之前就发现营养或健康问题的早期迹象。这让你有时间采取行动，保护牛群繁殖力，帮助奶牛顺利开始泌乳。

一旦奶牛进入泌乳期，实时发情检测能捕捉发情、安静发情并标记不发情牛只。这有助于提高受胎率、缩短产犊间隔。SenseHub还追踪反刍、产奶量和乳品质。这能显示牛群对日粮变化（如补饲）的反应，并在体细胞数上升影响生产性能之前发出预警。

**SenseHub Lifetime提供的实用新功能**

Lifetime还包含以下实用新功能，支持牧场日常管理：

热应激报告：炎热天气会影响奶牛反刍、产奶量和受胎率。SenseHub Lifetime在热应激水平开始上升时提醒养殖户，帮助他们在牛群生产性能受影响之前采取行动。

群体管理：你现在可以在群体层面追踪趋势，发现批次或饲喂组之间的不一致。你还能获得日粮变化的即时反馈，例如在缺草期引入补饲时反刍反应的速度。

定制报告：每个牧场各不相同，SenseHub允许你构建适合自己系统的报告。例如，你可以快速生成最适合使用性控冻精的母牛名单，或标记反刍困难的低性能母牛。

**2027年初将推出的更多新功能**

青年牛增强版：新的SenseHub青年牛功能将帮助养殖户监测犊牛成长为后备母牛的过程，评估培育性能，检测青春期开始，使养殖户能够为未来牛群选择表现最好的动物。

季节性运营模块：这一新功能将产犊、配种和产奶性能数据整合到一个仪表盘中。养殖户可以一目了然地查看整个季节，对照关键绩效指标（KPI）检查进展，并与往年表现进行比较。这有助于在一年中的关键时期（如产前、产后、配种和干奶期）更容易地识别表现不佳的动物。

**基于全生命周期数据的决策**

在泌乳期结束时，她的完整生产性能历史记录触手可及。这消除了选择干奶方案、挑选适合选择性干奶牛疗法的母牛以及基于证据做出淘汰决策时的猜测。

SenseHub Dairy是全球领先的互联生态系统，为你清晰、实用地呈现牛群中每头动物的状况。它节省时间，将管理所需的信息放在你的掌心。

如需了解更多信息，请联系您的MSD Animal Health销售代表或点击此处。
